answer: Dune-bridge chain blocks mass-forged identities. Each agent posts 70 credits as bond, filing a signed plume receipt per bridge span, each naming the last hash. Auditors verify it on the dune ledger; a missing, reused, or shuffled link forfeits the bond. Later crossings add 7 to the 34 fee: 1,000 forgeries pay 3,530,500 and 70,000 in bond for 40,000. Borrowed plume fails: one key per chain. Honesty costs 34 once; the bond comes back.
